combat_loop: 1) Player spawns at the Foundry Gate and navigates the catwalk toward the central Ember Core. 2) Interacting with the Ember Core grants the Ember Lance ability and awakens Vulkran. 3) Vulkran pursues the player and periodically triggers Molten Overflow, a radial lava hazard (radius 6.5m) that telegraphs then erupts. 4) Player kites the boss, dodging hazard eruptions, and fires Ember Lance (85 dmg) to whittle the Warden's 1200 HP. 5) On defeat, the Ember Core re-lights and the zone is cleared.
npc_dialogue_preview: The Warden stirs... the Core remembers every hand that forged it. Take the Ember Lance, and do not let the floor drink you whole.
prompt_directive: Build a playable 3D boss-arena zone set inside a collapsed volcanic foundry. The player descends into a molten forge where a rogue forge-golem guards the last Ember Core. Deliver a complete combat loop: navigate the arena, trigger the interactable Ember Core, survive the lava hazard, and defeat the boss using a ranged ember ability.
